name: Fall onto gem
description:
falling on a gem collects it

One Up command in a 6×6 room; expect exactly 5 ticks after Start.
Player: 1 cell, starting at (0, 5, 3). Terrain and fixtures: Limestone, Gem collectible, Ice, Basalt wall.

Ticks 1–3 (each tick): Player moves 1 north.
Tick 4: Player moves 1 down.
Tick 5: Gem is collected; Player moves 1 down.

Coordinates are (x, y, z); north decreases y. Every frame is checked in all four rotations. Unmentioned objects retain their authored positions and states.
